Test data of package ots

OUR OWN FILES (this directory, not third-party)
  SOURCES.txt, third_party.sha256, fetch-third-party.sh, and:

  headers.txt
    Lines "<height> <block id> <80-byte header, hex>" of real Bitcoin main chain
    blocks: height 0 (genesis) and the heights named by the Bitcoin attestations
    of the examples (129405, 358391, 465751, 466906, 912095). Fetched on
    2026-11-17 from https://blockstream.info/api/block-height/<height> and
    https://blockstream.info/api/block/<id>/header. A header is self-checking:
    the tests recompute its double SHA-256 against the block id and the target
    of its bits field. Block headers are facts of the public chain.

  Vectors constructed by the tests themselves (not from the reference client):
    fragments and calendar answers of the fake calendar (fake_test.go), the
    depth, node-budget, size and length boundary files (proof_test.go), the
    merge halves (the real two-calendars proof split by the test and merged
    back). RIPEMD-160 vectors are the published ones:
    https://homes.esat.kuleuven.be/~bosselae/ripemd160.html

THIRD-PARTY FILES (third_party/, not committed with our own files)
  third_party/opentimestamps-client-examples/: the whole examples directory of
  https://github.com/opentimestamps/opentimestamps-client at commit
  cd71c7609421bed2a07b9642a3c02a58c9fd2cdf (the last commit that touched that
  directory), with its original names and sub-directories invalid/ and sha1/.
  The .ots files were written by the reference client or library (real vectors,
  not constructed), except the three in invalid/, which are deliberately broken
  files of the same project. The sample files (hello-world.txt, merkle1.txt,
  ...) are the files the proofs are for. gdp2q25-2nd.pdf.ots was built by hand
  by a third party with the reference library (see gdp2q25-2nd.pdf.ots.txt).
  Licence of the project: LGPL-3.0-or-later.

  The directory is test data only: it is read by tests at run time, never
  embedded, never linked, never part of a binary. It is fetched by
  fetch-third-party.sh and checked against third_party.sha256 (a file with
  another sum, or a file that is not listed, fails TestThirdPartyManifest).
  When the directory is absent the tests that need it skip with a message naming
  it, and all others run.
